name: Ivan Ambrose Rosewood
source:
"Well, how about it? Fancy abandoning reality with me?"

A mysterious stranger with the same ability as Noah, Ivan forces his way into Noah's life - for what reason, nobody except him knows...

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound]Kickstarter[/url]]
